name: tradallo-reputation
description: MCP server for the Tradallo Verified Record Protocol — query cryptographically-verified human and AI-agent trading reputations (track records, agent version history, paginated UTRs, on-chain Solana memo notarization). Every response is JCS-canonicalized + ed25519-verified locally before returning.
